properties.description:
ARRIVED 2026-09-12. Fourth of the four Anthony ordered on 2026-09-11, and the one held behind the vocabulary guard. A Decision that has been set aside is now recordable as `deferred` — a field loop_status and what_next read — so a deferred idea stops sitting in the same bucket as a live question somebody is waiting on.

WHAT CHANGED: one value on Decision.status (schema/structure.yaml), the four-value list the core validator reads, the setter's served description, and the owner's-word rule. NOTHING in the readers changed, and that is the finding: loop_status' assigned decisions, what_next's open pool, undecided_decision_point, unreviewed_ideas, the parked-idea check and register_alternative's refusal to fork all test == "proposed", so a deferred decision drops out of every debt list by construction. The tests pin that as a contract rather than leave it a coincidence — measured on ONE node before and after, so they cannot pass by the lists being empty for some other reason.

THE OWNER'S WORD, extended deliberately: setting aside is the owner's act exactly as accepting is, so `deferred` carries an approver — landing a decision straight there with nobody's name is REFUSED, and moving one there through the setter without a name is REPORTED in the reply. But it does NOT trigger the settled-question prose check, which only means anything for `accepted`: a deferred decision's governed prose saying "still open" is TRUE. One flag became two. check_intent_authority.py reads it the same way.

SCOPED TO deferred AND NOT withdrawn, as the requirement said: the test for a new state is what would READ it, and for withdrawn nothing would.

THE GUARD IT WAITED FOR DID ITS JOB THE SAME DAY: two of the previous increment's tests used `deferred` as their unknown value and FAILED the moment it became known — correctly, there was nothing left to refuse. They now use a value no reflow2 will ever declare; the collector test keeps `deferred` as the pin on the real case.

WHAT IT DID NOT DO: move any existing decision. Ten say DEFERRED in prose and one — the tier-linking idea, "DEFERRED, SHAPE ONLY —" — is literally the measured case and still reads `proposed`. Moving it is the owner's word, and is put to Anthony rather than done.

NO VERSION NUMBER BY DESIGN.
properties.name: A decision set aside stops counting as debt
